_comment: PLACEHOLDER — this pin is NOT yet valid. open-msupply-frontend has not cut its first release, so no frontend-dist-<tag>.zip exists to pin against. Until it does, packaging must be driven with the FRONTEND_DIST_URL env override (see server/README.md, 'Serving front-end'). Once the FE repo publishes a release, bump `tag` to that release tag and `sha256` to the value from its published frontend-dist-<tag>.zip.sha256 sidecar. Fetched + verified by build/fetch-frontend.js.
